stem: The expression x^6y^3 \div \left( \frac{x^2}{y} \right) can be written as a product of two exponential terms with bases x and y for all values of x and y where the expression is defined. Choose the correct value of the exponent for each term.
instruction: Move the correct answer to each box. Each answer may be used more than once. Not all answers will be used.
notes: This is a drag and drop question asking to find exponents for bases x and y from the given expression.
